suites.name: Startup gate
suites.boundary: actual backend plus controlled slow transport
checks: Unsigned deep link retains path, query and anchor without mounting protected UI
Untrusted or expired local token cannot expose workspace content
Untrusted or expired local token cannot expose workspace content
A stale durable token cannot reopen an explicitly signed-out device

suites.name: Refresh/sign-out and cold offline
checks: Actual SDK refresh response, held after real server response, released after sibling logout cannot restore JWT or workspace
Controlled offline cold load needs consent for matching unexpired verified identity; saved local workspace remains readable

suites.name: Relay and migrations
suites.boundary: real backend; seeded external verification proof
checks: Missing provider configuration is rejected by the real backend
Fresh provider proof required; anonymous approval and unapproved claims rejected
One authorized claim issues a real same-account ColloSys session; replay/wrong secret fail
Cancelled, expired and fabricated requests cannot yield sessions
Revoking the authorizing session prevents a later desktop claim
Directory migration preserves IDs and references; repeated execution does not rewrite rows
Existing project identity migration is idempotent and rejects cross-account mutation
An interrupted directory migration rolls back earlier writes in the same real transaction

suites.name: Account cycles
suites.boundary: three real A/B/A and sibling sign-out cycles
checks: Real logout cycle 1: both windows clear, reloading stays signed out
Real logout cycle 2: both windows clear, reloading stays signed out
Real logout cycle 3: both windows clear, reloading stays signed out

suites.name: Real integration
checks: Product entry and former website URLs reach local sign-in without marketing pages
Real Codecast accounts, team and shared project
Two real directories connected using scoped device credentials
Manual additions, modifications and deletions reach the other member
Original password login and project Workspaces tab render for both members
Pause queues real edits; restart keeps queue and reconnect replays
Duplicate retry is acknowledged once; spoofing, sensitive files and outsiders rejected
Stale restore rejected; confirmed restore backs up A and leaves B/index untouched
Real Codex-format fixture is explicitly test data and read through the actual adapter
Original UI restore preview opens real on-disk checkpoint
Cold short project links outside the active workspace resolve and switch normally
Ten independent local WebSocket clients receive a real saved-file event
Signing out invalidates old browser JWT for local access and device minting

suites.name: Backup and recovery
suites.boundary: real encrypted bytes + isolated TEST records
checks: Real connector encrypts a captured checkpoint, Convex persists verified bytes, retries deduplicate and teammate/outsider reads fail
Wrong key fails; encrypted recovery exports to a new registered directory while both original working directories remain unchanged
Concurrent quota reservations allow one final slot, same-ID retries do not charge twice, corrupted bytes never become complete
Two concurrent 24 MiB uploads produce one durable manifest; streamed download matches the full digest and deletion revokes access
Delete/recreate and device revocation during streamed upload cannot publish stale backup bytes
Captured session pages, native task comments, frozen context, idempotent sending and concurrent handoff responses persist consistently
A moved task prevents acceptance but does not trap the recipient in a permanently pending handoff
A pre-upgrade multipart receipt is migrated before accepting more parts; duplicate paths fail without corrupting its count
Old session migration advances across 19 MiB of checkpoint history in bounded transactions without duplicate projection
Removing a member immediately revokes captured session, handoff and device backup access

membership removal revokes creator, assignee, CLI writes, sync cargo and new comment notifications
account deletion disables the 51st credential, device-token factory, JWT and team seat
revoked session dispatch explicitly preserves the retryable outbox contract
